title.narrative: Strengthened capacity of member States to ratify and apply international labour standards and to fulfil their reporting obligations

description.narrative: There are a number of up-to-date Conventions recommended for ratification by the ILOâ€™s Governing Body, including those that replace outdated or abrogated Conventions that are still to be ratified, and these include Convention 187 on the Promotional Framework for Occupational Safety and Health, and C160 on Labour Statistics. The drafting of the National Labour Migration Policy and support towards policy reform for a comprehensive social security system have highlighted the necessity to explore the feasibility of ratifying C97 on Migration for Employment and C143 on Migrant Workers (Supplementary Provisions) as Standards that underpin the National Labour Migration Policy and policy reform for social security. The Committee of Experts on the Application of Conventions and Recommendations reveal implementation gaps of ratified Conventions, including for the ratified Core Conventions. The onset of the COVID-19 pandemic revealed non-compliance with health and safety protocols resulting in provincial health authorities in the Eastern Cape drawing on ILO support to improve health standards and the functioning of health facilities through the application of ILO tools and methodologies to improve the quality of health facilities.
